0022600006.text: Cleveland opens its 2026-27 season on the road against a Philadelphia team that has not yet played a game this year. Cavaliers Khalifa Diop (knee), Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the 76ers have Ariel Hukporti out with a ruptured Achilles. Cleveland won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 115-101 victory in Cleveland on March 9, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Cavaliers a 40% chance to win.
